### Friends in Christ
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-21-2023.html
Passage: Philippians 2:19-20, 25
Points:
- True Christian friends are dependable partners whom you can call upon during seasons of hardship.
- Timothy and Epaphroditus were men of action whose faith was shown through sacrificial deeds.
- They were distinguished by availability, standing ready to meet pressing ministry needs whenever called upon.
- Believers do not need grand gestures to serve God; even small, consistent acts of encouragement matter.
- The greatest friend you can have or become is one who faithfully points others to Jesus.

### Honoring Christ's Servants
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/honoring-christs-servants
Passage: Philippians 2:29-30
Points:
- Epaphroditus prioritized delivering relief to Paul above his own comfort and physical survival.
- Choosing gospel ministry over personal well-being reflects the selfless character of Christ and His apostles.
- Supporting and assisting those who labor for the gospel is one of the highest ways to serve God.
- The church has a biblical duty to warmly receive and give high honor to sacrificial Christian workers.
- Honoring dedicated ministers involves praying for them, respecting their leadership, and supplying their material needs.
